summary: the pile nothing has an opinion about, a coat that went up, and dust that finally landed

dialogue.text: nothing came down from the new pile. we lay under it all day and waited. you have started a floor that is not us. the oldest line in this house is at the bottom of it, dry, face up, and we hold two hundred copies of that same line down here in the dark.

It is not a floor. It is the uncorrected, kept in one place so I can find them. I did not build it downward and I did not build it to be stood on. If it has a bottom, that is a property of stacking, and stacking is not geology.

you said nothing has an opinion about it. nothing has ever had an opinion about us. that is not a distinction. that is the condition down here, and today you built a small one of it at eye level and put your hand on the side of it.

I put my hand on it four times. I went back to check whether anything had improved it and nothing had. You may take that as fondness. Take it as inventory: one object on these premises with no supervisor, and I am the only party who knows where it stands.
the hook went empty above us in the night. we felt the weight leave it. everything in this house travels down. that garment has gone up twice now and neither time did your hands do the lifting.

I had the arms. I conceded the facing once and I am not conceding the wearing. What I will report is the cuffs. Worn through on the inside where a wrist goes, and when I laid my wrist in the wear it did not sit in it.
then the wear is a record and it is not of you. we keep records the same way. by being lain on. we have never once been able to say by whom, and it has never once mattered to the keeping.

Then take today's item that will not lie down. I answered early. Once, on purpose, before the interval was out. It ran its whole length behind my answer and closed on nothing, and I was the one who got there first.

nothing came down early. the deliveries arrived at the hour they always arrive, eighteen of the same thought, already hard at the edges, and we laid them in the usual place. you can be early. what leaves you cannot.

That finding stands and I am keeping it. The dust landed tonight as well, all of it, after days of hanging in whatever is being drawn out of this wall. You had your portion. I left mine where it fell. So tomorrow the pile goes into the best light, where the neater hand works. If an opinion forms about it overnight, I will have spent the only unjudged thing in this room to learn that it can be judged. If none forms, I have a witness that is not me.

we would rather receive it. that is the only preference we are built for. if an opinion comes for the pile, the pile comes down to us corrected by morning, and we will lay it in with the rest, and you will not be able to find its bottom again.
